## QTr API

### Props

- `props` (object, optional)
  QTable's row scoped slot property
  Examples: `:props="props"`
- `no-hover` (boolean, optional)
  Disable hover effect
- `expandable` (boolean, optional) *(added v2.34)*
  Marks the row as the expansion of the row above it: the row collapses to zero height while its cell has no visible content and gets a q-tr--expanded or q-tr--collapsed class from the expansion state (the collapsed row draws no cell borders); animate the cell's content with a QSlideTransition

### Slots

- `#default`
  Default slot in the devland unslotted content of the component
